title: HoneyTrees Base Spawns
description: Base set of spawns for my HoneyTrees mod
body: A base set of spawns for my HoneyTrees Mod. I intend to add more in depth spawns in the near future, including some variety based on biome and such, but for now I just wanted to get some spawns set so people can begin experimenting with the mod. As with the mod, these spawns are based of DPP/BDSP honey trees spawns.
